just_in.title: Doodhi Halwa: How to Make the Classic Bottle Gourd Dessert Without Khoya

just_in.title: Indian Physicist Deepak Dhar Wins 2026 Dirac Medal, Joining Hawking and Witten in Elite Physics Pantheon

travel.title: Jetstar to Charge Passengers for Overhead Locker Access Starting February 2027
travel.excerpt: Qantas's budget subsidiary will require travelers to purchase a Priority Carry-on add-on to stow bags in overhead bins, joining a global shift toward unbundled airfares.
travel.image_caption: Jetstar Airways will begin charging passengers for overhead locker access on select routes starting February 2027.
travel.nri_angle: Jetstar operates key routes between Australia and Southeast Asia used heavily by the Indian diaspora, and the carry-on fee will affect budget-conscious travelers on these corridors.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: Ranthambore Safari Bookings Crash as Record Demand Overwhelms New Portal
travel.excerpt: Rajasthan's revamped booking website for India's most popular tiger reserve buckled under massive traffic as the October–December season opened, highlighting surging wildlife tourism demand.
travel.nri_angle: NRIs and international tourists planning India wildlife trips face the same booking gridlock, with the new portal requiring passport uploads and foreign cards often failing on Indian payment gateways.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: Millions of Americans Discover Canadian Citizenship Pathway as Birthright Restrictions Loom
carousel.excerpt: Canada's Bill C-3 eliminated generational cutoffs for citizenship by descent, opening the door for millions of Americans with Canadian ancestry — just as the U.S. debates tightening its own birthright rules.
carousel.nri_angle: Indian Americans on work-based visas face unique anxiety as the birthright citizenship debate adds uncertainty to immigration planning, while the Canadian pathway offers a potential second option for those with ancestral ties.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: Explosive Drone at German Airport and Bulgaria Blast Raise NATO Security Alarm
carousel.excerpt: An armed drone found near Ukrainian cargo planes at Leipzig/Halle Airport and a separate explosion in Bulgarian airspace expose growing vulnerabilities in Europe's defence against unmanned aerial threats.
carousel.image_caption: Police officers stand near a Ukrainian Antonov cargo plane at Leipzig/Halle Airport after an explosive-laden drone was discovered on August 5, 2026. German federal prosecutors have launched a terrorism investigation into the incident.
carousel.nri_angle: NATO drone incidents highlight growing security threats across Europe, with implications for global stability and diaspora communities monitoring the Russia-Ukraine conflict.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: R Madhavan Pushes Back on Propaganda Tag: 'Being Indian Cannot Be a Crime'
carousel.excerpt: The actor defends Dhurandhar and Rocketry against accusations of nationalistic propaganda, saying honest storytelling about Indian identity should not be controversial.
carousel.image_caption: R Madhavan speaks during a promotional interview. The actor addressed accusations of propaganda surrounding his roles in Dhurandhar and Rocketry: The Nambi Effect.
carousel.nri_angle: Madhavan's defense of depicting Indian identity in cinema resonates with diaspora audiences who follow Bollywood's evolving global representation and the debate around nationalism in Indian entertainment.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: GodLike and Orangutan Give India Two Teams in PUBG Mobile World Cup Grand Finals for the First Time
carousel.excerpt: Orangutan qualified directly from Group A with 91 points and two Chicken Dinners, while GodLike advanced from Group B as India doubled its presence at the $3 million Paris event.
carousel.nri_angle: India doubles its representation at PUBG Mobile's premier global event for the first time, with GodLike and Orangutan both advancing to the Grand Finals in Paris.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: SpaceX Launches 24 Starlink Satellites From California in 90th Falcon 9 Mission of 2026
carousel.excerpt: SpaceX deployed another batch of Starlink V2 Mini satellites from Vandenberg Space Force Base as the company pushes past 10,800 satellites in orbit and maintains its record-setting launch cadence.
carousel.image_caption: A SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket lifts off from Vandenberg Space Force Base in California. The launch carried 24 Starlink satellites to orbit, marking the 90th Falcon 9 mission of 2026.
carousel.nri_angle: Starlink's global expansion offers improved broadband for diaspora communities in underserved areas, though its entry into India remains pending regulatory approval.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: Berkshire Earnings Beat Forecasts as Abel Accelerates Buybacks to $4.5 Billion
carousel.excerpt: Operating profit rose 16% to $12.98 billion in the conglomerate's second quarter under CEO Greg Abel, while share repurchases surged nearly 20-fold from Q1.
carousel.image_caption: Berkshire Hathaway CEO Greg Abel speaks at the company's annual shareholders meeting in Omaha. The conglomerate reported second-quarter operating earnings of $12.98 billion, a 16% increase from a year earlier.
carousel.nri_angle: Berkshire's renewed capital deployment and portfolio shifts may interest diaspora investors tracking major US conglomerates.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk
